title: Prediction Feature Snapshot
description: Identity and provenance of the full immutable feature input consumed for exactly one (match_id, prediction_cutoff) prediction context (Architecture Baseline section 7.6). Represents identity/provenance only, not the statistical feature payload/vector itself. Always distinct from a Training Feature Set (Architecture Baseline section 7.9), even when produced by the same feature logic. One immutable Prediction Feature Snapshot may be consumed by multiple Prediction Runs (ADR-009 decision 7).

prediction_feature_snapshot_hash.description: Identifies the exact normalized inference input.

feature_version.description: Identifies the feature-generation logic only, not the resulting snapshot content (Architecture Baseline section 7.3).

match_id.description: FootCap-internal, provider-independent match identity. External provider identifiers (e.g. API-Football match IDs) are stored through provider-specific mappings and are never the domain identity itself (ADR-009 decision 11).

feature_run_id.description: The Feature Run that produced this Prediction Feature Snapshot.
